### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **74** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/runtime/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**18** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/runtime/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os dev (command, 33 pages)`, `os serve (command, 33 pages)`
- **26** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **45** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f138b4ec8f2eaf196b03c23fddf81f1e34ce22dc` — the merge of head `f61f2e872f353e4f8c5db6ab9b1a4d4d5b5b76ee` into base `d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f138b4ec8f2eaf196b03c23fddf81f1e34ce22dc && git checkout f138b4ec8f2eaf196b03c23fddf81f1e34ce22dc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620 f61f2e872f353e4f8c5db6ab9b1a4d4d5b5b76ee && git checkout -B drift-repro d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620 && git merge --no-ff f61f2e872f353e4f8c5db6ab9b1a4d4d5b5b76ee

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d5666be8769a18c5c8d7695b3ac9100af2394620` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读(Tier H:本 PR 改了 `docs/adr/0131`)

**改了什么**
- `os dev` 遇到还是 v17 形态的本地 SQLite 开发库时，会先把主库和 telemetry 库（含 `-wal`/`-shm`）复制到备份目录，然后自动跑升级仪式（先出 plan，再 apply），完成后重新启动服务。生产环境的 `os serve`/`os start` 不变，仍然拒绝启动并给出命令。
- 仪式现在按对象所在的库分别处理主库和 telemetry 兄弟库。主库里残留的旧副本只告警、不处理。
- 2026-08-15 之前装的库里，8 个内置权限集是以 `managed_by='admin'` 存的，现在按种子副本处理，改用内置定义。
- 仪式自己做的决定会在 plan 和 apply 写入前以告警打印出来。
- 仪式命令新增 `--dev`。拒绝提示改成给出一条能跑通的命令（`--out PLAN`，然后 `--apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken`）。
- ADR-0131 增加 2026-10-16 修订，原文引用你的裁决。

**为什么改**：hotcrm 和 showcase 的长期开发库在 v18 下起不来，按提示跑升级又连续撞上 4 个平台缺陷（#23871 / #23872 / #23873；scim 那一条在 #23874）。客户的开发库会遇到同样的问题。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 自动升级只发生在 `os dev` 加本地 SQLite 文件的组合下，且一定先复制原库。失败会停下，并报出备份位置。
- 旧 admin 内置权限集上如果有人在 Setup 里改过，这些改动不会带过去，靠告警和备份兜底。
- 回滚：revert 这个 PR 即可。已经升级过的开发库可以从备份目录恢复。

**席位意见**：建议合入。在 showcase 真实库的副本上端到端验证过：手动仪式 9 步全部完成，`os dev` 自动升级后服务启动，health 返回 200。scim 修复 #23874 要先合或同时合，否则带那张旧表的库在 plan 第一步仍会拒绝。

**你要做的(一个动作)**：用 os-zhuang 批准本 PR。批准在案且 CI 全绿后，我开启 auto-merge 进合并队列。

## 席位核对

1. **Shape** — 21 files, +1514/−86: `packages/cli` (ceremony plan/apply, `dev`/`serve`/restart coordinator, migration composition), `packages/runtime` (boot guard option), `docs/adr/0131` (amendment), `content/docs` (CLI reference, permission sets), one changeset (`@objectstack/cli` minor, `@objectstack/runtime` minor). No `packages/spec/src`, so the Clause-② path limb is not hit.
2. **Premises measured** — Reproduced on copies of the real hotcrm and showcase 17.x dev databases with 18.0.0-next.2: plan refusal on `sys_scim_provider` (#23874); authored-conversion blocking on the 8 `admin`-stamped shipped sets; column-drops blocking on stale primary copies; the boot guard refusing on the sibling's `organization_id` columns after a complete primary-only run.
3. **Gates** — Local: cli and runtime `typecheck`, eslint on the changed files, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:adr-links`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (red on the first push; fixed in f61f2e872). PR check-runs on the current head are pending.
4. **Accepted deviations** — The `declared-rule-mirrors` departure still counts in the post-check, unchanged, as its CHANGELOG entry says. Seven `@objectstack/cli` test files fail on macOS for environment reasons only (`/private/var` tmpdir paths, the Asia/Taipei timezone, no util-linux `script(1)`); CI on Linux decides.
5. **Out of scope** — `sys_scim_provider` inventory row → #23874. The sharing-rule marker cycle → #15204 (comment by the sibling session).
6. **Landing** — Tier H: an authorized approval (`os-zhuang`; `hotlong` is the author) on record, every check green, then auto-merge into the merge queue. `Fixes #23871 #23872 #23873`.

Maintainer's word on the PR line · director seat (summon #43 continuation 2, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-16T13:18Z

- **The word:** 「同意」 in this session's chat on batch #356, which carried this PR as a line (approve or not), on the seat record 6215647152 and the 速读.
- **Approval, read at this write:** APPROVED by `os-zhuang` (review 5547935687, 2026-10-16T12:45Z, on `f61f2e872f35`). The click was the maintainer's; this seat clears the `needs-user-decision` label in this act (it marks a PR as awaiting the maintainer's review).
- **What lands it from here:** the at-tier `## Contract review` record on this head (none at the opening read; the governed face `docs/adr/0131` owes it), CI green (the `Test Core` shards and `Build Docs` were still running at the opening read), then the owning seat arms auto-merge into the queue. The pinned shipped-name copy (`SHIPPED_PERMISSION_SET_NAMES`, pinned equal to `securityDefaultPermissionSets` by test) is the one deviation from ruling 6213944432 口径 1 (「read from the manifest at run time」); the approval on this head confirms it as the accepted form, and the director records no objection.
